ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Part of the forest ecosystem is shown. Zooplanktons feed on what?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the lower left of the figure there is a “Phytoplankton” label, and next to it is a schematic diagram of phytoplankton; above it there is a “Zooplankton” label and a schematic diagram of zooplankton. A dashed arrow can be seen pointing upward from “Phytoplankton” to “Zooplankton”. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate food or energy pointing from the organism that is eaten to the eater. Therefore, the source of the arrow pointing to Zooplankton is Phytoplankton, showing that zooplanktons feed on phytoplanktons.
